hypotheses.name: Diffusion incremental gain after covariate adjustment
hypotheses.method: Fit baseline logistic models with covariates {source_degree, target_degree, coexpression, euclidean_distance, geodesic_distance} and extended models with diffusion-distance features at t={1,2,4,8} across immune/lung/external_lung (3 seeds, layers 0/3/7/11, source+target disjoint), then calibrated incremental gain with stratified diffusion-feature shuffles within degree x coexpression x geodesic strata.
hypotheses.result_value: +0.00346 mean delta AUROC overall; domain-split Fisher-significant groups 3/6; strongest immune source p=6.78e-08 and immune target p=3.84e-02
hypotheses.next_action: Run a targeted immune/external_lung rescue with stronger nuisance controls and the same stratified null to test whether incremental diffusion signal survives additional confound adjustment.

hypotheses.name: Convexity-deficit and detour-ratio graph geometry
hypotheses.method: Computed edge detour ratio (geodesic/euclidean) and endpoint convexity-deficit (1 - geodesic-neighborhood Jaccard) on scGPT kNN manifolds (immune/lung/external_lung, seed42_main, layers 0/3/7/11, source+target disjoint), combined them with geodesic baseline via logistic scoring, and calibrated with degree x geodesic-length x coexpression matched label permutations.
hypotheses.result_value: +0.01706 mean delta AUROC (combo - geodesic); mean combo AUROC 0.5682; Fisher-significant delta in 4/6 domain-split groups
hypotheses.next_action: Promote to multi-seed replication and test incremental value against diffusion-adjusted baselines.

hypotheses.name: Tri-domain cycle-consistent cross-model alignment
hypotheses.method: Aligned 260 shared gene symbols across immune/lung/external_lung using non-GW Procrustes maps from scGPT layer embeddings to Geneformer embeddings, then applied tri-domain consensus-regularized cycle-consistent refinement and evaluated cycle-return plus edge-transfer AUROC against random orthogonal-map nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: +0.02692 cycle-return improvement (p=0.00621 vs random), but mean edge-transfer AUROC delta vs independent maps was -4.55e-05 with 0/3 domains significant
hypotheses.next_action: Only continue this branch with biological-anchor regularization and a hard gate requiring positive edge-transfer delta, not cycle consistency alone.
